requiredConstruction: Remove the retired Blender facade and projection relief from the live palace assembly; retain their files only as historical evidence.
Build one closed broad cathedral base with real side and rear walls and footprint depth 0.72-0.82 of front width.
Build a two-stage central keep, closed drum, faceted hero dome, compact crown, and four volumetric quadrant satellite towers with solid collars and roofs.
Build four squat occupied shoulder bays embedded into the base: front-left, front-right, rear-left, rear-right. Each must have closed backplanes, reveal depth, and a low faceted hemidome.

Build a thick front entrance buttress with side returns. Royal doorway is first: outer width 1.05-1.12 at accepted facade width 3.38, purple insert near 0.47 wide with width-to-height 0.60-0.70, visible center seam, two handles, and readable bee crest.
Build the dark honeycomb rose as geometry near 0.82 wide and subordinate it to the doorway. Door outer width to rose must stay near 1.15:1.
Build four countable dominant front facade bays around 0.70-0.78 wide and subordinate upper bays around 0.45-0.54 wide. Large occupied masses must dominate tiny ornament.
Wrap eaves, buttresses, honeycomb bands, windows, and structural ribs around corners onto side walls. No detail strip may terminate at a front camera boundary.
Build a quieter subordinate rear service apse/entrance and stepped occupied mass so rear views remain authored without mirroring the royal front.
Use delicious glossy honey drips selectively on eaves and channels, while keeping the palace base as readable masonry rather than a melted honey mound.
Real geometry must carry silhouette, dome contours, tower spacing, openings, tier setbacks, and all paper-edge risk at every 45-degree orbit. No runtime image projection may define the silhouette.
